engine.name: Validate locked product contracts
engine.command:
python3 scripts/check_contracts.py
python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_*.py'

engine.name: Build exact Rust, Edge, pgrx and PostgreSQL prototype
engine.command: python3 scripts/retry_snapshot_build.py docker build --file Dockerfile.p0 --build-arg PG_QDRANT_SOURCE_SHA=${PG_QDRANT_SOURCE_SHA} --tag pg-qdrant-p0-${PGQ_RUN_ID} .

engine.name: Build the independent lexical candidate experiment
engine.command: python3 scripts/retry_snapshot_build.py docker build --file Dockerfile.p0-lexical --build-arg PG_QDRANT_BASE_IMAGE=pg-qdrant-p0-${PGQ_RUN_ID} --tag pg-qdrant-p0-lexical-${PGQ_RUN_ID} .

engine.name: Characterize isolated Tantivy lexical primitives
engine.command:
docker create --label io.pg_qdrant.ci.lifecycle=1 --label io.pg_qdrant.ci=${PGQ_RUN_ID} --name pg-qdrant-p0-tantivy-run-${PGQ_RUN_ID} --memory=512m --memory-swap=512m \
  --pids-limit=64 --cpus=1 --network=none pg-qdrant-p0-lexical-${PGQ_RUN_ID} bash -c '
    set -euo pipefail
    ulimit -c 0
    timeout --kill-after=5s 45s target/tantivy-probe/debug/pg-qdrant-tantivy-feasibility \
      > /src/artifacts/tantivy-probe.json
    cat /src/artifacts/tantivy-probe.json
  '
docker start --attach pg-qdrant-p0-tantivy-run-${PGQ_RUN_ID}

engine.name: Collect isolated lexical evidence
engine.command:
mkdir -p artifacts/tantivy
if docker inspect pg-qdrant-p0-tantivy-run-${PGQ_RUN_ID} >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  docker cp pg-qdrant-p0-tantivy-run-${PGQ_RUN_ID}:/src/artifacts/. artifacts/tantivy/
fi

engine.name: Test Edge ENOSPC on a dedicated 32 MiB tmpfs
engine.command:
docker create --label io.pg_qdrant.ci.lifecycle=1 --label io.pg_qdrant.ci=${PGQ_RUN_ID} --name pg-qdrant-p0-disk-run-${PGQ_RUN_ID} --memory=5g --cpus=2 --network=none \
  --tmpfs /pgq-p0-faults:rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=32m,uid=10001,gid=10001,mode=0700 \
  --env PG_QDRANT_ENOSPC_DIR=/pgq-p0-faults \
  pg-qdrant-p0-${PGQ_RUN_ID} python3 scripts/run_disk_probe.py
docker start --attach pg-qdrant-p0-disk-run-${PGQ_RUN_ID}

engine.name: Collect bounded disk-failure evidence
engine.command:
mkdir -p artifacts/enospc
if docker inspect pg-qdrant-p0-disk-run-${PGQ_RUN_ID} >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  docker cp pg-qdrant-p0-disk-run-${PGQ_RUN_ID}:/src/artifacts/. artifacts/enospc/
fi

engine.name: Test full-text ENOSPC recovery on an exact 384 MiB tmpfs
engine.command:
docker create --label io.pg_qdrant.ci.lifecycle=1 --label io.pg_qdrant.ci=${PGQ_RUN_ID} --name pg-qdrant-p0-full-text-disk-run-${PGQ_RUN_ID} --memory=5g --cpus=2 --network=none \
  --tmpfs /pgq-p0-faults:rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=384m,uid=10001,gid=10001,mode=0700 \

docker start --attach pg-qdrant-p0-full-text-disk-run-${PGQ_RUN_ID}

docker create --label io.pg_qdrant.ci.lifecycle=1 --label io.pg_qdrant.ci=${PGQ_RUN_ID} --name pg-qdrant-p0-full-text-clean-run-${PGQ_RUN_ID} --memory=5g --cpus=2 --network=none \

engine.name: Require zero-write refusal of the unsupported 128 MiB full-text budget

docker create --label io.pg_qdrant.ci.lifecycle=1 --label io.pg_qdrant.ci=${PGQ_RUN_ID} --name pg-qdrant-p0-full-text-capacity-run-${PGQ_RUN_ID} --memory=5g --cpus=2 --network=none \

  --env PG_QDRANT_ENOSPC_DIR=/pgq-p0-faults \
  pg-qdrant-p0-${PGQ_RUN_ID} python3 scripts/run_disk_probe.py --profile full-text --characterize-128-capacity-refusal
docker start --attach pg-qdrant-p0-full-text-capacity-run-${PGQ_RUN_ID}

  --env PG_QDRANT_P1_STORAGE_TEST=1 --env PG_QDRANT_P1_DISK_DIR=/tmp/pgq-p1-product.storage/data/pg_qdrant_p0/db-5.indexes \

static.name: Run Python regressions and syntax checks
static.command:
python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_*.py'
python3 -m compileall -q scripts

static.name: Ensure an unverified preview cannot be released
static.command:
if python3 scripts/check_release_gate.py \
      --attestation packaging/release-attestation.example.json; then
  echo 'Release gate incorrectly allowed draft release' >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo 'Expected: incomplete P0-P5 draft release rejected'

lifecycle_failure.name: Exercise failed-container evidence retirement
lifecycle_failure.command:
docker create --label io.pg_qdrant.ci.lifecycle=1 --label io.pg_qdrant.ci=${PGQ_RUN_ID} --name pgq-lifecycle-failed-${PGQ_RUN_ID} --network=none --memory=128m --pids-limit=32 pg-qdrant-act-runner:29.8.0-node24 sh -c "mkdir -p /src/artifacts /tmp/cluster; echo diagnostic > /src/artifacts/result; echo checkpoint > /tmp/cluster/state; exit 7"
docker start --attach pgq-lifecycle-failed-${PGQ_RUN_ID}

lifecycle_failure.name: Exercise successful-container retirement after an independent failure
lifecycle_failure.command:
docker create --label io.pg_qdrant.ci.lifecycle=1 --label io.pg_qdrant.ci=${PGQ_RUN_ID} --name pgq-lifecycle-success-${PGQ_RUN_ID} --network=none --memory=128m --pids-limit=32 pg-qdrant-act-runner:29.8.0-node24 sh -c "mkdir -p /src/artifacts; echo success > /src/artifacts/result"
docker start --attach pgq-lifecycle-success-${PGQ_RUN_ID}
